presentation.name: Navigator
presentation.subtitle: Human in command
presentation.revision: The Drummer front door with a jump through the far gate to each world, rooms that open out of the fold, and a bridge for wide screens with the page on the left and the sky in a window on the right.

statement: V44 Navigator gives the Drummer front door and its seven stations in the platinum cAshIo identity a jump between worlds: opening a world card flies the camera through the far gate and the room opens out of that world's light, and a wide screen becomes a bridge with the page on the left and the sky in a window on the right. The gate is generative artwork. The helm and E.V.E. are scripted browser experiences that send no requests. Observation records and historical releases retain their original dates, versions and limits.
